highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update.
highlights_body: This preview tracks the current upstream renderer and corrects two HarfBuzzSharp enum surface details.

breaking.title: HarfBuzz combining-class enum name corrected
breaking.body: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 has been renamed to CCC132 to match HarfBuzz. Replace the old member name in source code.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined removed
breaking.body: The aggregate GlyphFlags.Defined mask is no longer exposed. Combine the concrete flags your code needs instead.

bullets.detail: The preview aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 154.

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m154.
v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.body: It begins the 4.154 release line with the current upstream graphics engine.
